test_pytree_dataclass_decorator: test the penzai.core.struct.pytree_dataclass decorator to create a JAX-compatible dataclass with custom tree_flatten_with_keys and tree_unflatten methods
test_struct_pytree_structure: test the penzai.core.struct.Struct base class with pytree_dataclass decorator to define fields marked as non-pytree nodes via metadata
test_mutable_init_proxy: test the pytree_dataclass decorator with use_mutable_proxy_in_init=True to allow mutable __init__ that assigns to self before returning an immutable instance
test_field_inheritance: test the pytree_dataclass decorator with has_implicitly_inherited_fields=True to allow subclasses to inherit parent dataclass fields
test_struct_attribute_helpers: test the Struct class attributes_dict and from_attributes methods to serialize and reconstruct pytree dataclass instances
